meta.purpose: Hints and counts in ink-soft; 0.95rem is the text floor.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--action,#0a6b5a); background:var(--action,#0a6b5a); color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; transition:background-color .14s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-hover,#07564a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action,#0a6b5a); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action: sheet fill, teal text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #0a6b5a; background:#fbfcfb; color:#0a6b5a; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#e0f0ec; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0a6b5a; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Offers a destructive action; the confirm is the filled red button.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #b3261e; background:#fbfcfb; color:#b3261e; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#fbe9e7; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0a6b5a; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Third and later actions: underlined teal text, no box.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding:4px 6px; border:0; background:none; color:#0a6b5a; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color:#07564a; background:#e0f0ec; border-radius:8px; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0a6b5a; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:12px 14px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #7a8f88; border-radius:8px; color:#14201d; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; caret-color:#0a6b5a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0a6b5a; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color:#b3261e; }

components.name: Staff Bar Item
components.description: Daily task link; the current place is filled ink, never teal.
components.html: สมาชิก วันนี้
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; padding:8px 24px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #7a8f88; background:#fbfcfb; color:#0a6b5a; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#e0f0ec; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0a6b5a; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-current { background:#14201d; border-color:#14201d; color:#fff; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Glyph, word and border form; shown here: confirmed (solid) and waitlisted (double amber).
components.html: ยืนยันแล้ว รอคิว
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:1px 14px 1px 10px; border-radius:999px; border:2px solid #14201d; background:#fff; color:#14201d; font-weight:600; font-size:.95rem; line-height:1.6; } .ds-pill-wait { border-style:double; border-width:5px; padding:0 12px 0 6px; background:#fbeedd; color:#9c500c; border-color:#9c500c; }

components.name: Stubbed Ticket
components.description: Numbered registration: teal-tint stub, vertical dashed perforation with notches, body.
components.html:
คิวที่12

คุณสมชาย ใจดี

ลงทะเบียนวันนี้
components.css: .ds-ticket { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:104px minmax(0,1fr); background:#fff; border:1px solid #9fb3ad; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(20,32,29,.12),0 16px 30px -12px rgba(20,32,29,.45); font-family:Sarabun,Thonburi,sans-serif; color:#14201d; } .ds-stub { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; padding:20px 8px; border-right:2px dashed #8fa39d; background:#e0f0ec; border-radius:16px 0 0 16px; } .ds-stub::before,.ds-stub::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:-12px; width:22px; height:12px; background:#dce8e5; box-shadow:inset 0 3px 4px rgba(20,32,29,.3); } .ds-stub::before { top:-1px; border-radius:0 0 11px 11px; } .ds-stub::after { bottom:-1px; border-radius:11px 11px 0 0; } .ds-stub-label { font-size:.95rem; color:#3f504a; } .ds-stub-num { font-family:Kanit,Sarabun,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-size:3rem; line-height:1; } .ds-ticket-body { padding:22px 24px; min-width:0; } .ds-ticket-body h3 { font-family:Kanit,Sarabun,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:1.35rem; line-height:1.4; margin:0 0 .25rem; } .ds-ticket-body p { margin:0; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-strip { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; border:1px solid #9fb3ad; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; overflow:hidden; font-family:Sarabun,Thonburi,sans-serif; color:#14201d; } .ds-strip li { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; padding:12px 16px; border-right:2px dashed #b6c8c3; } .ds-strip li:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-strip span { font-size:.95rem; color:#3f504a; } .ds-strip b { font-weight:600; } .ds-warn { background:#fbeedd; }

narrative.overview:
Every record is a numbered ticket. The page is one cool thermal-paper sheet laid on a pale mint-grey waiting-hall ground; the page title is the ticket header, torn off from the body by a dashed perforation whose ends are punched into the sheet's edges. Near-black green ink does the talking, queue numerals are large and tabular, and rows are divided by tear lines rather than boxes inside boxes. It reads like a Thai clinic or government queue slip, and deliberately unlike a card-grid SaaS dashboard or a Google Form.

The users are older staff and caregivers on phones and office screens, Thai only. Density is calm and touch-first: 18px body, 48px minimum targets (52-56px for primary controls), generous line height for Thai script. Colour is rationed: ink carries structure and state, teal means "you can press this", amber means "look here", red means error or destruction.
keyCharacteristics: Thermal sheet on mint ground, separated from its header by a dashed perforation with edge notches.
Numbered stubbed tickets for registrations; counts and queue numbers in Kanit, tabular, the largest thing in their region.
Status is a drawn glyph plus a word plus a border form, never hue alone.
One loud action per region; the rest are secondary, outline, danger or quiet.
The current place is filled ink, never teal.
One soft ticket shadow; no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Pressable-Only Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal marks things that respond to a press. Status, headings, the current place and decoration use ink or amber.

rules.name: The Never-Hue-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status carries a drawn glyph, a word and a border form: solid, dashed, 5px double amber, dotted and struck, solid red on red tint, dotted muted.

rules.name: The Numerals-Are-Kanit Rule
rules.body: A count or a queue number is Kanit, tabular and the largest thing in its region.

rules.name: The 0.95 Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 0.95rem; product users are older and read on phones.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Plastic Rule
rules.body: Depth is the one ticket shadow. No hard offset shadows, no glow; the only other emphasis is the 3px teal focus outline.

dos: Do put content on the Thermal Sheet over the Waiting-Hall Ground, with the title torn off by a dashed perforation and edge notches.
Do divide rows and sections with dashed tear lines (perforation), not solid boxes.
Do pair every status with a glyph, a word and a border form.
Do set counts and queue numbers in Kanit 600, tabular.
Do keep targets at 48px or more, primary controls at 52-56px, and control borders at control-border (3:1).
Do show one primary action per region and demote the rest to secondary, outline, danger or quiet.
Do mark the current place with Green Ink fill and white text.
donts: Don't use teal for status, headings, current place or decoration.
Don't use amber except for waitlisted and attention.
Don't convey state by colour alone.
Don't build grids of identical boxes or stacked Google-Forms blocks.
Don't add hard offset shadows or glow, or replace the ticket shadow with plain borders.
